name: deepseek-harness
description: Run DeepSeek Harness locally in a visible Web session controlled and reviewed by Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run and watch a local DeepSeek coding agent.
interface.longDescription: Codex connects to or starts DeepSeek Harness Web, returns a clickable live-session link, delegates a scoped coding task, and independently reviews the workspace changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up DeepSeek Harness Web on first use, give me its clickable session link, delegate this coding task, then review and verify the result yourself.
